annotations.title: Check a token or recipient before an on-chain transaction

description: Call this before every on-chain transaction you are about to send: before buying or swapping into a token, and before transferring funds to an address. Give the token contract and/or the recipient address and the chain (base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, or solana for token mints). Nothing is sent. Returns advice: ok, caution, do_not_send or unknown, with reasons: honeypot and sell-block detection, buy and sell tax, liquidity, pool age, owner powers, and for the recipient whether it is a contract, whether it has ever transacted, and sanctions, phishing and theft flags. Only send if advice is ok.

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, optimism, polygon or solana

to.description: Address you are about to send funds to

token.description: Contract address of the token you are about to buy, swap into or send

name: check_before_send
title: Check a token or recipient before an on-chain transaction
